1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas element with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   const { width, height } = canvas;
12:   // Pre‑generated starfield to avoid jittery stars each frame
13:   const starCount = 100;
14:   const stars = Array.from({ length: starCount }, () => ({
15:     x: Math.random() * width,
16:     y: Math.random() * height,
17:   }));
18: 
19:   // Load sound effects (placeholders, ensure files exist in project)
20:   const soundMove = new Audio('move.wav');
21:   const soundPoint = new Audio('point.wav');
22:   const soundExplosion = new Audio('explosion.wav');
23:   // Optional background music loop
24:   const bgMusic = new Audio('bg-music.mp3');
25:   bgMusic.loop = true;
26:   bgMusic.volume = 0.3;
27:   bgMusic.play().catch(() => {}); // ignore autoplay restrictions
28: 
29:   // Ship configuration
30:   const ship = {
31:     width: 40,
32:     height: 20,
33:     x: width / 2 - 20,
34:     y: height - 30,
35:     speed: 5,
36:     movingLeft: false,
37:     movingRight: false,
38:   };
39: 
40:   // Asteroid configuration
41:   const asteroids = [];
42:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
43:   const lastSpawn = { time: 0 };
44:   let score = 0;
45:   let gameOver = false;
46: 
47:   // Input handling
48:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
49:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') {
50:       ship.movingLeft = true;
51:       soundMove.currentTime = 0;
52:       soundMove.play();
53:     }
54:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') {
55:       ship.movingRight = true;
56:       soundMove.currentTime = 0;
57:       soundMove.play();
58:     }
59:   });
60:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
61:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') ship.movingLeft = false;
62:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') ship.movingRight = false;
63:   });
64: 
65:   function spawnAsteroid() {
66:     const radius = Math.random() * 15 + 10;
67:     const x = Math.random() * (width - radius * 2) + radius;
68:     const speed = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
69:     const rot = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
70:     const rotSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02; // small rotation per frame
71:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speed, rot, rotSpeed });
72:   }
73: 
74:   function update(delta) {
75:     if (gameOver) return;
76:     // Move ship
77:     if (ship.movingLeft) ship.x = Math.max(0, ship.x - ship.speed);
78:     if (ship.movingRight) ship.x = Math.min(width - ship.width, ship.x + ship.speed);
79: 
80:     // Spawn asteroids
81:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn.time > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
82:       spawnAsteroid();
83:       lastSpawn.time = performance.now();
84:     }
85: 
86:     // Update asteroids
87:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
88:       const a = asteroids[i];
89:       a.y += a.speed;
90:       a.rot += a.rotSpeed; // rotate asteroid
91:       // Check collision with ship (simple AABB vs circle)
92:       const shipRect = { x: ship.x, y: ship.y, w: ship.width, h: ship.height };
93:       const distX = Math.abs(a.x - (shipRect.x + shipRect.w / 2));
94:       const distY = Math.abs(a.y - (shipRect.y + shipRect.h / 2));
95:       if (distX > (shipRect.w / 2 + a.radius) || distY > (shipRect.h / 2 + a.radius)) {
96:         // no collision
97:         } else {
98:           // collision detected
99:           gameOver = true;
100:           soundExplosion.currentTime = 0;
101:           soundExplosion.play();
102:         }
103:       // Remove off‑screen asteroids and increment score
104:       if (a.y - a.radius > height) {
105:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
106:         score++;
107:         soundPoint.currentTime = 0;
108:         soundPoint.play();
109:       }
110:     }
111:   }
112: 
113:   function draw() {
114:     // Background gradient
115:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
116:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001d3d');
117:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0a0a2a');
118:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
119:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
120: 
121:     // Simple starfield (pre‑generated)
122:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
123:     for (const s of stars) {
124:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 1, 1);
125:     }
126: 
127:     // Draw ship as a triangle for better visual
128:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00aaff';
129:     ctx.beginPath();
130:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.width / 2, ship.y); // tip
131:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.height);
132:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.width, ship.y + ship.height);
133:     ctx.closePath();
134:     ctx.fill();
135: 
136:     // Draw asteroids with radial gradient shading and rotation
137:     for (const a of asteroids) {
138:       ctx.save();
139:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
140:       ctx.rotate(a.rot);
141:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, a.radius * 0.3, 0, 0, a.radius);
142:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#aaaaaa');
143:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#444444');
144:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
145:       ctx.beginPath();
146:       ctx.arc(0, 0, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
147:       ctx.fill();
148:       ctx.restore();
149:     }
150: 
151:     // Draw score
152:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
153:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
154:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
155: 
156:     // Game over overlay
157:     if (gameOver) {
158:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
159:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
160:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5555';
161:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
162:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
163:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
164:     }
165:   }
166: 
167:   let lastTime = 0;
168:   function loop(timestamp) {
169:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
170:     lastTime = timestamp;
171:     update(delta);
172:     draw();
173:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
174:   }
175: 
176:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
177: })();
